worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.summary: Forms a huge icicle above the target and drops it straight down: foes in the landing ring are scoured by shards, a solid hit may leave them flinched, and the ground freezes over. The landing is fixed at cast, so the target can step aside before it lands; the high drop is heavier but slower, the close drop faster and surer.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.use.3: Drop over cover onto a head
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.descriptio: Foes within %2$s blocks of the landing each take about %1$s damage; the target's defence, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The icicle forms %1$s blocks above the target, falls at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block hit radius.
Cast at a single target within %1$s blocks.
A solid hit has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s.
The frozen ground stays for %1$s s, then the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.tall.on: High drop on: it forms higher for about 15%% more power and a wider shatter ring, but adds 6 ticks of wind-up, falls slower and adds 8 ticks of cooldown, giving the target time to step aside.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.tall.off: High drop off (close drop): lighter and narrower, but it falls faster and is almost impossible to dodge, with a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.growth.0: At level %1$s the shards rise to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.growth.1: At level %1$s the shards rise to %2$s power, a %3$s block shatter radius, and the flinch chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.iciclecrash.preference: On: the icicle forms higher, hits harder and shatters wider, but the longer, slower fall gives the target time to step aside. Off: a close, fast drop that is lighter and narrower but almost impossible to dodge.
The companion considers Icicle Crash only while a foe is this close; higher opens at range, but the longer fall lets the target slip out of the landing.
Fresh only: skip targets already flinched by another move and save this one for a target that can still be flustered. Always: treat it as an ordinary attack and ignore target status.
